title: Aurora pgvector: Semantic Search Layer
description: Add semantic vector search capability to Aurora PostgreSQL using pgvector extension.

steps.action: Enable pgvector: CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS vector; verify with SELECT extversion FROM pg_extension WHERE extname='vector'
Add embedding columns to target tables: ALTER TABLE analytics_docs ADD COLUMN embedding vector(1024)
steps.verify: \d analytics_docs shows embedding column of type vector(1024)
steps.rollback: ALTER TABLE analytics_docs DROP COLUMN embedding

steps.action: Generate embeddings via Bedrock Titan Embeddings V2 for existing rows: Lambda function batch-processes rows in chunks of 100
steps.verify: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM analytics_docs WHERE embedding IS NULL returns 0

steps.action: Create HNSW index for approximate nearest neighbor search: CREATE INDEX ON analytics_docs USING hnsw (embedding vector_cosine_ops) WITH (m=16, ef_construction=64)
steps.verify: \d analytics_docs shows hnsw index on embedding column; EXPLAIN ANALYZE shows index scan

steps.action: Test semantic search: SELECT title, 1 - (embedding <=> $1) AS similarity FROM analytics_docs ORDER BY embedding <=> $1 LIMIT 10
steps.verify: Query returns relevant documents; top result similarity > 0.85 for known test query
